item.summary: Hyperliquid had revenue of 713 million US dollars over the past 12 months, Investornytt reports, citing Bloomberg Businessweek. Founder Jeff Yan wants to reach US traders through regulated partners, while CME and ICE have pressed regulators about such platforms; ICE has itself invested in Trade.xyz. According to Event Horizon Labs, fewer than one in four accounts on the platform are profitable.
